claim: On the maintainer's Steam Deck, Nibbi 0.1.4's editor draws and closes when its managed environment uses the accepted DirectComposition reference runner. One observation of editor presentation and removal; not a qualification of audio, state, automation or any other plug-in.

source.note: Deck Test 9 software from pull request 223. The assessment fixes in this change were not installed on the Deck for this run.

fixture.host: Steam Deck, SteamOS desktop session, KDE Wayland with XWayland
fixture.editor_framework: JUCE 9.0.2, Direct2D window context; d3d11, dxgi, d2d1 and dcomp are ordinary imports and DCompositionCreateDevice is imported by name

transition.mechanism: manager experimental-runner, DirectComposition reference candidate, after experimental_disable of the published default-graphics candidate
transition.rollback: Original environment marker, onboarding record and registry retained in the receipt directory; the original runner remains installed.

operations.note: The offered predecessor was the earlier Wine D3D11 trial, so this candidate inherited that label; under the reference runner policy the launch overrides are identical.

editor_pixels.context: manager graphics assessment, isolated host, default-graphics candidate
editor_pixels.capture: one X11 capture of the editor's own window; client area 1200x426

editor_pixels.context: Bitwig Studio 6.1, Nibbi inserted on an instrument track of an existing project, editor window opened by the DAW
editor_pixels.capture: two X11 captures of the editor's own window two seconds apart, byte-identical; client area 1200x426

bitwig.editor_close: A polite window close removed the editor window within the first half-second poll; the earlier 30-second removal stall did not recur. The exact duration was not recorded.
bitwig.after_close: Device remained loaded and enabled with its parameters listed.
bitwig.quit: Bitwig exited within two seconds of declining to save; no error dialog was present in the window list. The project was not saved.

tool_observations: Every retained assessment on this Deck, on the stock runner, the touch-routing runner and both DirectComposition runners, reports the same Direct3D 11 adapter: description 'ATI Radeon HD 5600 Series', vendor 0x1002, device 0x68D8, including the launches labelled runner defaults.
The installed Proton launcher sets its DXVK DLL overrides only inside prefix setup, which the runinprefix verb skips; a live host's WINEDLLOVERRIDES contained no d3d11 or dxgi entry.
The OpenGL probe's renderer name was null in all seven retained assessments while its driver version string was present.
Serum 2, published and listed as supported, received requirement direct_composition_runner on the touch-routing runner; its module imports d3d11 and d2d1 only.
nonclaims: Audio, MIDI, automation, state save and recall, processing restart and endurance were not exercised.
The earlier temporary-state save error on quit was not reproduced or explained; one clean quit does not establish that it is fixed.
No loaded-module map of a live plug-in host was read, so the Direct3D 11 provider on stock-runner launches is inferred from the adapter identity and launcher behaviour, not observed directly.
No claim for other JUCE Direct2D plug-ins, other runners, Ubuntu or any other host.
Nibbi remains experimental and unqualified in the support matrix.
Captured images are not retained in Git; raw logs and captures stay outside the repository.
